verdict.rationale: Better Auth markets 'Auth for AI agents. MCP auth, token exchange, and agent delegation' and ships building blocks for agent identities. These include an MCP plugin that acts as an OAuth authorization server, an API Key plugin with expiration, rate limits and remaining-count controls, Device Authorization for CLI clients, and org-level roles and permissions. The evidence does not show these combined into dedicated per-agent least-privilege identities, and revocation is only evidenced for user sessions and a homepage activity mock. Missing for 10: documented per-agent machine identity distinct from human users, per-key/per-agent permission scoping, explicit instant revocation of agent credentials or API keys, depth on the agent delegation/token-exchange feature, independent hands-on corroboration.
